baseline_verification: Every experimental baseline CSO is byte-identical to the shipped generic 0fa378f4 CSO
scene: Synthetic resident textured edges; identical A/B resources and coefficients; ordinary P50/P65 and Balanced packed P50/P65/P100; SDR, HDR mappings 0/2/4/6
settings: Small Standard gain coefficients, Structure=Intensity=1, debug/compare off. No NR/private DLSS inference is timed.
formats: Resolve: FP16 proxy/residual/low/output, FP32 native guide/warp. Fusion: FP32 synthetic native colour/depth/motion sources; FP16 packed colour, R32F depth, RG32F motion.
method: 8 ABBA/BAAB blocks; 8 warmup quartets/block; 40 measured quartets/block; 4 repetitions per timestamp; 640 samples/variant/profile. Entire block submitted without CPU idle gaps. No sample filtering.
scope: Final resolve dispatch plus output UAV barrier, or full two-versus-one pack dispatch sequence with identical transitions. Excludes neural inference, other stages, CPU setup, one-time warp lookup creation and complete game.
interpretation: Use paired quartet deltas and block medians. Separate specialization and lookup-after-specialization runs are not added arithmetically; final directly measures both production changes against the baseline.
quality: 5952 candidate/production comparisons, 968170176 uint32 words, exact equality, plus 25 final timed 4K output comparisons. Fusion is rejected for sample/value differences; not embedded in runtime.
